ETAPKI Phase 2 analysis fixture

Synthetic format-0 MIDI note sequence used by core_tests.cpp:
60, 62, 60, 72, 69, 65

Expected conservative detections include:
- U2R: 60 -> 62 -> 60
- I8 and LP: 60 -> 72
- I3 and DLP3: 72 -> 69
- DI: 60 -> 62 (two semitones)
- BM/MM/EM: first, middle, and final track notes
- QN: each note duration is 96 ticks, below the 256-tick reference threshold

The fixture is synthetic and does not alter any imported formula source.
